description: Native Decision 3.0 service with choice, noul and score probabilities over text, JSON, images and video. BF16 backbone and FP32 readout. A 32768-token input context and one concurrent sequence bound this profile. Estimated peak is 0.20 times 130663231488 bytes plus 8 GB runtime overhead; physical Spark qualification is pending. Requires native System One gateway support.
title: D3 NANO vLLM single Spark
